summary: Iteration 4 backend-only verification: full pytest suite 44/44 passing (test_invariants 17, test_transport_config 10, test_trial_gather 17). Live regression against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirmed all 6 frozen SIMULATED scenarios return exact expected goal_state and guardian_blocks. Per-transport telephony/status shape is correct (both transports NOT_CONFIGURED with 'missing' list). REAL mode with either transport correctly returns HTTP 400 with 'NOT_CONFIGURED' and lists the specific missing env keys (TWILIO_CONVERSATION_RELAY_WSS_URL appears in the CONVERSATION_RELAY error). No credential values are echoed in any response body. Source inspection confirms twilio_service.start_outbound_call is only invoked in the REAL branch of /api/contracts/{cid}/execute, guarded by consent → config → E.164 checks.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan handler (non-blocking, minor).
server.py is 788 lines — approaching split threshold; consider splitting telephony/contract routers into submodules.

In execute REAL branch, os.environ['PUBLIC_BASE_URL'] would KeyError if config check ever drifted; safe today because transport_status verifies presence first, but using os.environ.get with an explicit guard would be more defensive.
test_credentials: None required — no auth used; Twilio env kept empty by design.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a fresh contract + consent via live API; no persistent fixture data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live regression script at /app/backend/tests/test_live_scenarios.py — runnable via `python tests/test_live_scenarios.py`. It exercises /api/telephony/status, all 6 frozen scenarios, both REAL-mode 400 paths, and credential-leak checks. Env at /app/backend/.env keeps 5 Twilio placeholders EMPTY — do not populate them. pytest suite mocks twilio_service.start_outbound_call so no real Twilio API is invoked.
